purpose: Independent read-only visual review of other agents' final Steam artwork exports

reference.method: Previously viewed in this same subtask session before portrait generation; used as the approved visual reference for this independent review.
reference.expected_composition: Woman warrior is largest and foremost; Song Jiang and Lin Chong remain smaller supporting figures behind her.

tools: Read-only PNG IHDR, byte length and SHA-256 checks
FFmpeg in-memory 231x87 Lanczos preview of small.png; no preview file written
methodology.text_check: Visual inspection of exact title 水浒英雄传 (水浒 / 英雄传) and subtitle 八幕战役 on assets intended to contain text; no OCR used.
limitations: This is model visual inspection, not a human unfamiliar-player/readability study.
No Steam upload, live page, client crop, language override, or actual logo overlay was inspected.
Generatively recomposed assets are checked for recognizable character and costume consistency, not pixel-identical faces.

observed.notes: Large woman dominates the center-right foreground. Ochre-robed Song Jiang and armored Lin Chong are smaller behind her; title and subtitle occupy the black ink field at left.

limitations: Lower body and distant supporting figures extend beyond the composition by design; no principal face or letter is clipped.

observed.notes: The wide recomposition retains the woman as the dominant central foreground subject and both men behind her at right. All five title characters and four subtitle characters are complete.

limitations: Checked at exported resolution; no responsive Steam header crop was observed.

rendered_views.method: Read-only FFmpeg in-memory scale=231:87:flags=lanczos preview, emitted directly to the image viewer; source unchanged

observed.notes: Title is clear in the 462x174 export and remains readable in a 231x87 preview. The woman remains the obvious primary subject. The subtitle is decipherable in the 231x87 preview but is materially smaller and less prominent than the title.

limitations: 231x87 is a local preview, not an inspected Steam client rendering.
The small subtitle and background faces are detail-limited at 231x87; no claim of effortless subtitle readability on every display or UI scaling setting.

rendered_views.method: view_image detail=original was automatically resized by the tool from 3840x1240

observed.notes: Hero has no baked-in words. The left half has lake, mountains, reeds and no principal characters; the dominant woman and the two supporting men occupy the right. This preserves left-side space for a separate library logo.

limitations: Full 3840x1240 pixel-level inspection was not possible in this tool response; the observed rendition is 2048x661.
Left-side space is textured landscape, not a flat-color field. Actual logo contrast and client placement require an overlay/client check.

observed.notes: The 16:9 promotional artwork keeps the large woman at center-right, the two supporting men behind her, and the complete gold title/subtitle on the left black ink field. All three principal faces and the title strokes are fully inside the image. Costume, palette and ink/parchment treatment remain consistent with the approved artwork.

limitations: Reviewed as a standalone 1920x1080 image; any later platform crop, compression or embedded text overlay remains outside this review.

overall.notes: All five assigned exports were visually inspected. No required correction was found within this scope. The small preview and hero/logo/client limitations remain explicitly recorded.
